objective.title: Qualify a bounded exact LaTeX import contract and explicit ambiguity convention

declared.summary: Qualify a closed .NET 10 LaTeX subset importer: exact fractions and real expressions, explicit multiplication, optional caller-declared x(y) convention, and typed refusals for non-injective square/power display, invalid syntax, unsupported macros and limits. declared.value: Let independent Math consumers import selected exact LaTeX without silently guessing function application, executing TeX, converting to binary64 or claiming a general inverse renderer.

Pass 50 independent GREEN tests and one recovered RED; run focused codecs plus exact IR and quantities regressions under locked .NET 10 Release build.
Pack and independently inspect three local Math archives with actual net10 nuspec/dependency/SHA-256 receipts; execute eight isolated pinned NuGet-only consumer oracles.
